parsed.note_claim: Demonstrators tore down barriers and clashed with police, but police used tear gas to maintain control of the National Palace.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Demonstrators dismantled parts of a barrier protecting the National Palace, where Sheinbaum lives. Police protecting the compound used tear gas on the crowds.
parsed.reason: The BBC article directly confirms that protesters dismantled barriers at the National Palace and that police used tear gas to maintain control, substantiating the note's claim.
